name: 保版式批量翻译（多市场图集一键换语言）
trigger_phrases: 一键翻译整套 listing 图
translate the text in all images

prompt_template.type: layout-preserving text translation across an image set
prompt_template.subject: Translate the text in all images into {target_language}. Preserve the layout exactly: same font size relationships, same positions, same colors, same line breaks; only the language of the text changes
prompt_template.integration: translated text must fit naturally in the original text areas — adjust tracking/leading minimally if needed, never reflow or resize design elements
prompt_template.quality: accurate natural {target_language} copy appropriate for e-commerce, correct diacritics and punctuation, no leftover source-language fragments

market-pack.description: 一次多语言（同套图出 N 个语言版本）

overrides.subject: Generate a {target_language} version of each image, translating all visible text. Preserve layout exactly: positions, sizes, colors, line breaks unchanged; only the language changes. Produce one version per image.

platform_constraints: translated claims must stay legally compliant in the target market (see platform-constraints.md Layer 2 for market-specific claim rules)
